comment:
The panel's RESET button and its RST input do different things. The button zeroes the displayed time and leaves the pulse divider alone (Set.cpp:44-47, 78); the input restarts the four-beat pulse count and leaves the time alone (Set.cpp:49-55, 80). The manual says this; the panel does not.

The RUN button toggles between running and paused (Set.cpp:63-71) while the RUN input only starts (Set.cpp:57-61, 87), so a trigger cannot pause the timer.

The timer is driven entirely by the clock: elapsed time is accumulated in whole clock intervals at Set.cpp:93-97, and an interval more than two and a half times the previous one is discarded. With no clock patched the display never leaves zero.
